The native widgets directory was empty, so every shared web dependency this widget pulls in (WidgetShell, WidgetEventFeed/EventFeedItem, types.WidgetProps, ui.Badge, data-display.TimeStamp/TimelineItem, feedback.EmptyState, data-display.DataFreshness) is reproduced inline native-safe, matching the GlancePage/RateLimitStatusPanel idiom.

L1 useMemo kept; used for feedItems (L79) and the inlined WidgetEventFeed sort/slice. L1-2 react-i18next useTranslation('dashboard') -> native English-default `t` with {{var}} interpolation preserving every widget.*/freshness.* key.

L3 lucide-react PlayCircle/CheckCircle/XCircle/Clock -> no native icon font: header icon = accent '\u25B6' PlayGlyph; per-run icons collapse to the four distinct-icon glyphs (CheckCircle->OK, XCircle->X, Clock->CK, PlayCircle->PL) while the exact per-status hex colour is preserved.

L4-5 ui.Badge -> local StatusBadge (success/warning/danger tint map); data-display.TimeStamp -> formatRelativeTime label (no native time_format_default pref, so 'auto' resolves to the relative ladder).
L6 feedback.EmptyState -> shared native EmptyState (web single `message` -> native EmptyState `title`, empty `message`).
L7 useAutomationHistory imported unchanged from ../../../api/hooks/useAutomations (same /automations/history?limit=20 path, same default limit 20, same 30s refetch interval).

L8 dateFormat.formatDurationMs inlined verbatim ('Nms'/'N.Ns', '\u2014' fallback via isFiniteNumber). L9 numberFormat.fmtInt/fmtNumber inlined verbatim (default precision 2, en-US grouping, safeNumber guard).

L12 EventFeedItem type -> local interface (glyph replaces the web ReactNode icon). L13 WidgetProps -> local WidgetSize/WidgetProps subset (only size.cols read).
